about_the_game:
🍋 Run the sweetest stand in town!

Cozy Lemonade Stand is a wholesome shop sim about growing, mixing, and serving refreshing drinks on sunny afternoons. Harvest fresh ingredients, craft delightful recipes, decorate your stall, and turn a tiny sidewalk stand into the coziest spot on the block.

🌿 Harvest & Forage
Start simple and hands-on:
• Grow lemons, strawberries, and mint in your little garden plots
• Forage seasonal extras like blueberries or lavender
• Upgrade tools to harvest faster and keep produce fresh

🥤 Mix & Perfect Your Recipes
Balance sweetness, tartness, and aroma to match customer tastes:
• Combine fruits, herbs, syrups, and ice for unique blends
• Unlock special add-ons (sparkling water, honey, vanilla)
• Save favorite recipes and chase 5-Star “House Specials”

😊 Serve Customers (and learn their quirks)
Your neighbors each have a vibe:
• Kids love sweeter mixes; joggers want light and icy
• Office crowds rush at lunch—prep in advance for the rush
• Earn tips for fast service, perfect recipes, and cute presentation

🪴 Decorate & Upgrade Your Stall
Make it yours, piece by piece:
• Add awnings, fairy lights, chalkboards, planters, and crates
• Buy better juicers, coolers, dispensers, and prep space
• Unlock themed styles: Rustic, Garden, Festival, Seaside

⛅ Weather, Events & Daily Planning
Every day plays a little different:
• Heat waves boost demand (but melt ice faster!)
• Rain slows foot traffic—offer warm lemonade and samples
• Weekend fairs and markets bring crowds and special orders

📈 Grow Your Cozy Business
A gentle tycoon loop with no stress:
• Price smart, manage stock, and avoid waste
• Reinvest earnings into garden plots, tools, and décor
• Meet milestones to expand your menu and reputation

📒 Collections & Goals
• Recipe Book: track discoveries and seasonal flavors
• Customer Journal: remember preferences and stories
• Daily Goals: tiny challenges for bonus coins and décor

💛 Cozy at its core
Low-pressure, satisfying, and sunny—the joy of fresh ingredients, happy customers, and a stand that feels like home.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS (Proton-8 Recommended)
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 or higher, ATI X1600 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Proton-8 Recommended

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or above
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 (M2 and M3) or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1280x720 minimum resolution, OpenGL 2.0 Support, and recommended dedicated graphics card with 128 MB of RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: M1, M2, M3 Silicon Mac & ARM Supported
